modelingNotes: St. Patrick's Cathedral, Fifth Avenue — procedural, CC0-1.0, no textures. bun generators/st-patricks-cathedral.ts

Map frame: x across the church, y along its axis with +y towards the east end (Madison Avenue), z up, metres. Placed at bearing 118.4°, so the twin spires face Fifth Avenue on the model's -y side. Origin is on the axis at the centroid of the OSM outline (way/266010379).

Footprints follow OSM: the outline (way/266010379, ridge 42 m), the two spire parts (way/161156112, way/161156113, 100.5 m) and the east end with the ambulatory and lady chapel (way/266010403, 29.4 m). Everything is mirrored about x = 0, as the building is.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "st-patricks-cathedral", model "st-patricks-cathedral"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/st-patricks-cathedral.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
